title: Portal frame lateral sway
description: Reusable SVG component showing the undeformed and prescribed laterally swayed geometry of a single-bay fixed-base portal frame.
learningObjectives: Relate a prescribed story drift ratio to lateral top displacement and visualize the corresponding kinematic sway of a fixed-base portal frame.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party visual assets or runtime dependencies.

verification.notes: Candidate includes explicit kinematic assumptions and reproducible geometry checks. Independent engineering, browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Reserved structures-agent task str-frame-sway; original dependency-free SVG/DOM implementation.
